If you're looking for a GP, look elsewhere.

It's not because of how difficult it is to get an appointment or the lacklustre reception staff who will ignore people right in front of them. As bad as that is, this GP employs a Dr Richards and a Dr McKenzie, and they are the very worst.

Both are rude, inconsiderate, needlessly argumentative about the most trivial matters, and would rather call their patient a liar than admit to being wrong.

This surgery sent me to the local mental health team for diagnosis. The last time I spoke with Dr Richards, he insisted I do not have the condition they diagnosed me with. They weren't even the first people to diagnose the condition. And it was the mental health nurse at the surgery who told me about it!

The other GPs are not nearly as bad, but odds are you will end up having to deal with Richards or McKenzie. I am 45, have worked in multiple fields, including customer service and they are not just the worst GPs I have ever encountered, they are the worst people I have ever encountered.
